games.title: Hypixel SkyBlock (Minecraft UGC)
games.note: Started from a minimalist 2011 floating-island survival map inside Minecraft and evolved on the player-run Hypixel server into a persistent MMO economy with millions of concurrent builders, dungeons, and auction houses.

games.title: FiveM / GTA Roleplay (NoPixel)
games.note: Community multiplayer modification framework for Grand Theft Auto V that turned Los Santos into player-governed improv stages—paramedics, courtroom lawyers, mechanics, and heist crews—driving billions of livestream hours before Rockstar officially acquired Cfx.re in 2023.

games.title: Adopt Me! (Roblox)
games.note: Co-created inside Roblox Studio by two young developers (Josh Ling and Bethink), growing into a remote 40-person studio whose virtual pet-trading and home-decorating world hit nearly 2 million simultaneous players.

games.title: Brookhaven RP (Roblox)
games.note: Built by solo creator Wolfpaq inside Roblox with zero grind gates or paywalled progression—just an open digital neighborhood dollhouse where hundreds of millions of kids invent their own stories together.

games.title: DOORS (Roblox)
games.note: Crafted by two young indie creators inside Roblox with original acoustic sound design and learn-by-dying monster tells—proving UGC toolsets could deliver atmospheric co-op horror played billions of times.

games.title: Fortnite Creative & UEFN
games.note: Opened Unreal Engine 5's Verse scripting, custom assets, and direct creator revenue-sharing inside Fortnite—turning a battle royale into a live user-generated arcade where small indie teams ship instant cross-platform islands.

games.title: Dress to Impress (Roblox)
games.note: Launched by a 17-year-old lead creator and a small student team on Roblox, turning timed runway styling, layering creativity, and peer voting into a cultural phenomenon across Gen Z, streamers, and mainstream fashion collaborations.
